notes:
Summary: Early-stage dev tools startup building a GitHub-style PR review assistant focused on large monorepos and internal code review workflows. Main ask: very low-latency streaming of token-level diffs into IDE and PR UI, plus reliable comment generation + reranking to avoid noisy suggestions.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-21: Architecture deep-dive with infra + security (Fireflies ff_2026-02-21_arch_review). SE demo of streaming path; they want <80ms median for 512 token streaming chunks.
- 2026-02-15: Initial POC wrap-up: 2-week trial using hosted API showed good qualitative suggestions but latency variance. POC doc: drive://PatchPilot/POC-results-diff-tests.xlsx.
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (AE Lila, SE Ethan). Quote from eng lead: "We need deterministic pinning — production can't float model versions mid-release."

Technical requirements / priorities:
- Model/version pinning per repo + per-route rollout (must support pin to major.minor).
- Low-latency streaming to both web PR UI and VSCode copilot integration (bidirectional).
- Reranking: prefer to downrank boilerplate or autogenerated comments; eval harness to measure precision@k on past PR corpus.
- Prefix/KV caching for large code contexts across repos to reduce token cost.
- Audit logs + token-level cost breakdown required for chargeback.
- KMS integration: customer-managed key for any persisted caches.
- Residency: some diffs cannot leave corp VPC during evaluation (on-prem option desirable).

Procurement / commercial notes:
- Interested in a private deployment or Dedicated pool with burst into hosted for weekend CI workloads. Lower cost per token is meaningful — tight ARR constraints.
- Target ARR they're comfortable with: $120k-$300k; procurement expects solution + 12 month commitment.

POC results & technical feedback:
- Quality: comment generation looked promising on JS/TS but struggled with large Go diffs. Want model recommendations for polyglot codebases.
- Latency: streaming spikes when concurrent CI-driven PRs hit 40+ parallel sessions; suspect batching fallback needs tuning.
- Pinning: want rollout controls (canary percentage by repo) + automatic fallback to smaller model when GPU saturated.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Can Redwood expose model pin metadata in the console and via API per-route?
- How is KV cache encrypted/managed when deployed on-prem?
- SLA for median p99 streaming latencies and how fallback routing behaves across Dedicated/Hosted.

Next steps (short):
- SE to run 2 new perf profiles (50 devs sim) by 2026-03-05.
- Security to confirm SOC2 artifact delivery by 2026-03-12.
- Final commercial review with procurement week of 2026-03-22.
